**Sort the Terrain panel your way**

The Terrain panel's categories are now yours, saved with the map: drag a terrain onto another category, or right-click it and choose Move to, to sort it there or into a new category; rename a category (double-click its title), move it up or down, fold it, hide its terrains or delete it, its terrains going to Other. Hide from the list takes a terrain you never use out of the lists without touching the map; it waits under Hidden at the end of the panel. A WorldPainter world's long Imported list can at last be sorted. Asked for by Jack (Fornad).
